description_en: Deletes an SMS signature that is no longer needed
description_zh: 如果您不再使用某个短信签名，需要删除签名时，调用此接口或在短信服务控制台删除短信签名
name: DeleteSmsSign

parameters.help_en:
The SMS signature. You can delete signatures that have been withdrawn, failed the review, or passed the review. Signatures that are under review cannot be deleted.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419282.html operation to query the signatures that have been submitted under the current account, or view the signature list on the Signature Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign) page in the China Short Message Service console.
<notice>Deleted SMS signatures cannot be recovered, and the deleted signature can no longer be used to send messages. Proceed with caution.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
短信签名。支持删除已撤回、审核失败或审核通过的签名，审核中的短信签名不支持删除。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419282.html接口查询当前账号已申请的签名或在短信控制台签名管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign)页查看签名列表
<notice>删除短信签名后不可恢复，且后续不可再使用该签名发送短信，请谨慎操作。></notice>
parameters.name: sign_name
